overrideHooks.basis: EntityArgument.parse(StringReader): 1.21's public method_9318 is 1.21.1's method_61178 (both parse with selectors allowed: 1.21 through EntitySelectorParser(reader) = this(reader, true), 1.21.1 through method_9318(reader, true)); brigadier's parse(StringReader) bridge calls it in both

1.21.1's brigadier 1.3.10 parses command arguments through ArgumentType.parse(reader, source) (ArgumentCommandNode.parse), which EntityArgument answers with method_61179; in 1.21 (brigadier 1.2.9) every parse went through parse(reader) to the 1.21 override, so the override answers this entry point too, with V's super semantics (super.method_9318 is renamed to method_61178: selectors allowed at parse, permission still checked at resolution by EntitySelector.checkPermissions in both)

abstractFills.basis: javadoc (abstract, no default): a 1.21 type has no sync codec or predicate, so it cannot be synchronized; Fabric's sync code casts every type answering true to its own AttachmentTypeImpl

javadoc (abstract, no default): the handler of the connection being configured, tracked as Fabric tracks its configuration addon; outside configuration it throws as ClientConfigurationNetworking.getSender() does
FluidVariantImpl (abstract, no default): no default components, the variant's changes applied; named per interface because a fill's under is matched without Fabric API's hierarchy
ItemVariantImpl (abstract, no default): the component map of the stack toStack() makes
Fabric's own implementations (abstract, no default): an ItemVariant's stack components, else the object's default components (an item's, none for a fluid) with the variant's changes applied
FluidVariantImpl (abstract, no default): the same fluid with the variant's changes and then the given ones merged
the javac bridge a FluidVariant compiled against 1.21.1 has: TransferVariant's own default of this descriptor throws, FluidVariant's covariant redeclaration is the implementation
ItemVariantImpl (abstract, no default): the same item with the variant's changes and then the given ones merged
the javac bridge an ItemVariant compiled against 1.21.1 has (see FluidVariant)

ledger.net/fabricmc/fabric/api/attachment/v1/At: not bridgeable: a 1.21 builder builds types that cannot be synchronized -- 1.21.1's Fabric sync code (AttachmentTargetsMixin, the chunk / entity / world sync mixins) reads the packet codec and sync predicate off Fabric's own AttachmentTypeImpl, which only Fabric's BuilderImpl makes, and no API attaches them to another type; accepting the call and building an unsynced type would silently drop the synchronization the caller asked for
